summary: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive STEM game concept designed for students ages 7–12 that turns real NASA space-exploration constraints into hands-on gameplay. Most space education either oversimplifies survival into static posters or jumps straight into advanced math. This project bridges that gap by placing young learners inside Mission Control to manage a lunar or Martian outpost. Players must split limited power across four competing systems: life support oxygen, radiation shielding, power budgeting, and hydroponic food production, learning that no choice is free and every decision compounds over time. Emergencies are driven by real NASA open data, including solar flare alerts from DONKI, astronaut health research from OSDR, and Artemis and Mars surface telemetry, alongside realistic deep-space communication delays. Whether built as a survival simulator, decision tree, or mission dashboard, the trainer teaches authentic space engineering trade-offs through engaging interactive play.
details:
ASTRA – Junior Astronaut Mission Academy

ASTRA is an interactive web-based learning platform designed to introduce young learners to the exciting world of space exploration and astronaut training. Our goal is to make space education more engaging, practical, and accessible by allowing users to experience astronaut-like challenges through an interactive digital academy.

The platform provides a structured learning experience where users can explore different training activities, learn about space science, and develop problem-solving skills through interactive missions. It includes a colorful academy interface with progress tracking, experience points (XP), stars, badges, achievements, and ranking systems to motivate learners. Users can participate in space-related challenges and explore concepts connected to astronaut preparation and Moon missions.

Our project aims to make complex space-related topics easier to understand through gamification and interactive learning rather than traditional text-based education. It encourages curiosity, creativity, critical thinking, and interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).

We developed the web application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with AI-assisted development tools to support the design and implementation process. The application is deployed as a publicly accessible web app using Netlify.

What makes ASTRA creative is its combination of educational content, gamification, and simulated astronaut-training experiences in one platform. Our vision is to inspire the next generation of space explorers by making learning about space more enjoyable and accessible.

ASTRA is an independent educational prototype created by Team XENOPULSE, inspired by the challenges and possibilities of future human space exploration.
